scope: No user token: verifies native file encoding and HTTPS transport to authentication boundary; no photo created or notification sent.
reportedSymptom: Network error when sending after adding a friend
rootCause: Expo SDK 57 replaces global fetch with expo/fetch. Its multipart encoder rejects React Native uri-only file descriptors before sending HTTP; api.uploadMoment used that legacy descriptor and mapped the encoding exception to NETWORK.
fix: Append an expo-file-system File so the SDK reads the local image bytes.

regression.sdkMultipartEncoder: Uses installed Expo implementation, including binary body and recipient fields.

pending: Authenticated photo delivery between physical devices requires retry with the updated APK.
